extraBotSnapshotCalls.label: review-phase independent reproduction (ticks 17 and 79)
extraBotSnapshotCalls.method: Read-only snapshot on the fixed candidate.html launched by the reviewer's own reproduction script (node .review-bot/repro.mjs, not npm run smoke). MOBA_SMOKE_RENDERER was not set, so tests/client/browser-smoke/options.mjs defaulted to renderer='gpu' and launchOptions() returned args: []; --use-angle=swiftshader was absent. chromiumSandbox stayed true and --enable-unsafe-swiftshader stayed removed through ignoreDefaultArgs, with no new launch flag. Off-origin requests were blocked, no input events were sent and no state was injected. The actual WebGL renderer class of this call was not captured.

This call sampled ticks 17 and 79 rather than 13 and 75; it matched the published samples by the same 62-tick delta and did not recreate them exactly.
